children: On November 19, 2026, First Breach received notice from Nasdaq that its stock had closed below the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, violating Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The notice does not immediately affect the listing, and the company has until May 18, 2027, to regain compliance by meeting the minimum price for at least 10 consecutive business days.
